component.name: Loukai
component.summary: Real-time karaoke player with stem control and coaching

description.p: Loukai is a professional karaoke player that supports multiple formats including KAI (stem-separated audio), CDG, and standard audio files. It features real-time audio mixing, vocal effects, pitch coaching, and a web interface for song requests.
Features:

ul.li: Play KAI files with separated stems (vocals, drums, bass, other)
CDG+MP3 support with synchronized graphics
Real-time vocal effects (autotune, reverb, echo)
Independent PA and IEM outputs for performers
Pitch coaching and vocal analysis
Web-based song request system
Butterchurn visualizations and effects
Queue management and playlist support
Create stem-karaoke files from any song, fully on-device (WebGPU AI — works offline after first model download)

screenshot.caption: Loukai karaoke player with library, queue, and mixer controls

description.p: The web admin's settings sidebar can now be hidden on a phone

ul.li: The queue sidebar had no way to get out of the way on a phone, even after 0.14.3's layout fixes. The hamburger button already used to hide this sidebar in the desktop app now does the same in the web admin, and starts hidden so the queue is visible right away

description.p: Web admin now works on a phone

ul.li: The admin screen was desktop-only: the tab row overflowed, the queue sidebar left no room to manage the queue, and the player controls squeezed the seek bar away. Tabs now collapse to a hamburger menu on a phone, and player controls wrap to fit

description.p: Fixes visual effects appearing on the wait screen when turned off

ul.li: Turning off visual effects in Server settings still showed them on the wait screen before a song was playing; the setting only applied once a song loaded or was changed live. The wait screen now respects the saved setting from app startup, same as during playback

description.p: Fixes singers connecting from a hostname, and a responsive kiosk layout

ul.li: Singers reaching the app by its machine name or a .local address (the usual way a tablet finds it on the LAN) could load the page but never connect for live updates; the request page kept retrying forever instead of showing the queue. The server now allows the same same-origin connection Socket.IO already trusts from a plain IP

The kiosk request page now fills the screen on a tablet or laptop instead of staying a narrow mobile-width column, moves search to the left with a Request button on each result, and lists the artist on its own line under the title
Artist names in search results and the song list are now shown in blue

description.p: A kiosk page for a shared tablet, and song search that actually finds the song

ul.li: NEW: an optional kiosk page for a device everyone shares, such as a tablet on the KJ booth - it never remembers a name, so every request asks who is singing and nobody gets queued under the last person's name (Server settings, off by default)

Library search in the app now finds songs it used to miss entirely: typos, words in a different order, and artist-plus-title queries like "queen bohemian" all match, because every search box in the app now uses the same ranking as the singer page
Search results are no longer cut off at 8 rows, so the song you wanted stops getting dropped before it can be shown on a large library

description.p: Fixes song requests when the app is behind a reverse proxy or tunnel

ul.li: Singers can now scan the QR code and browse and request songs when the app is reached through a reverse proxy or tunnel; the page and its requests previously failed with server errors

description.p: The custom QR address and the port setting now actually take effect

ul.li: The custom QR code address now updates the on-screen QR code and the Server tab as soon as it is saved, and reverts correctly when switched back off
The web server port setting is now saved and used (it was ignored, always starting on 3069); changing it takes effect after restarting the app

description.p: Fixes the web pages failing to load when run with npx

ul.li: Fixes the song request page and the whole web admin failing to load (server errors) when the app was started with "npx loukai-app"; installed desktop builds were unaffected
Fixes the "Powered by Loukai" link on the song request page pointing at the wrong domain

description.p: Custom QR code address, plus fixes for tooltips, minimized visuals and a crash on quit

ul.li: NEW: point the QR code at your own address - useful when a reverse proxy, tunnel or custom hostname fronts the app, so singers scan something they can actually reach (Server settings)
Tooltips stay visible instead of flashing and vanishing
Visuals keep running when the main window is minimized, so projected karaoke and remote viewers no longer freeze while the control window is out of the way
Fixes a crash when quitting the app or turning the web server off during a song

description.p: Play from the couch: full gamepad navigation, plus a fix for npx launches

ul.li: Game controller support: drive the entire app with a gamepad — d-pad or stick moves a visible focus ring, A activates, B closes dialogs, Start toggles play/pause, shoulder buttons switch tabs
Controllers are read natively (SDL), so they keep working when the window isn't focused
Fixed "npx loukai-app" failing to find Electron on every launch after the first
Disabled spellcheck underlines in text fields
Security updates for networking dependencies

description.p: Fixes the blank window on startup, plus smarter chords and editor search

ul.li: Fixes the app opening to a blank window on new installs and updates (a bad default in saved settings crashed the player screen; existing installs heal automatically)
Fixes the editor keyboard freezing after deleting or retiming lyric lines
Chord detection v2: bass-first root notes for much more accurate chords
Evaluate/Reevaluate Chords button in the song editor
Editor search overhaul: better multi-word matching, artist matches on short queries, stem-song-only results

description.p: Security dependency updates

ul.li: Updates bundled dependencies for newly published advisories (node-tar, body-parser); no feature changes from 0.10.0

description.p: Chords on screen - play along with any song

ul.li: NEW: real-time chord display for players following along on guitar, bass, or keys - current chord big, next chord previewed, top right of the karaoke screen and on every phone/browser viewer
Chords are detected automatically when a song is created, and existing library songs analyze themselves the first time they play with the display on
Works on CDG/MP3 songs too (display only)
Chord names transpose live with the key shift (Am becomes Bm at +2)
Edit chords in the song editor like lyrics: timeline rows, pick-list names, and a tone preview per chord
Off by default - enable Show Chords under Display Options
Editor fix: deleting a lyric line no longer risks timing fields showing the wrong line's values
Clearer wording on the web Create tab

description.p: Key shift

ul.li: NEW: transpose the loaded song up or down 6 semitones live from the player or the web admin - the band and guide vocal shift together, the singer's mic never does
Shows the transposed key while shifted (Am to Bm at +2) when the song's key is known
Per-song by design: resets to 0 on every load and is never saved to settings
Zero cost when unshifted - the pitch processor is fully bypassed at 0

description.p: Editor save no longer freezes the app

ul.li: Saving a song in the editor ran the whole file rebuild on the process that routes keyboard input, freezing typing app-wide for seconds on larger files - the save now runs in a worker thread and input stays live throughout

description.p: Stem mixer on every output, and a rock-solid Linux launch

ul.li: NEW: per-stem volume and mute on each output bus - give the singer a vocals-on monitor mix while the room hears the karaoke mix, live from the web admin
Monitors (IEM) start fully muted so nothing leaks on single-sound-card setups; enable exactly the stems you want
Linux: native Wayland with GPU song creation AND casting to phones/browser viewers working at the same time; terminal launches always bring up the window
A second launch focuses the running app instead of failing
Better default lyrics model (Whisper large-v3-turbo, multilingual with language auto-detect)
Stem separation runs on the GPU or fails fast with a clear message - no more silent hour-long CPU runs
Newly created songs appear in the app library instantly - no manual sync
Queue Load works for .stem.mp4 files; editor timestamp fields no longer eat keystrokes; legacy .kai code paths removed

description.p: WebGPU creator everywhere, AIFF support, and a fully pure-JS runtime

ul.li: Create karaoke from any surface: in-app, phone-commanded host creation, or the offsite creator
Higher-quality separation option (htdemucs_ft ensemble) with live progress and cancel
AIFF (.aif/.aiff) import support
Fixed song requests from the LAN web page
Creator libraries ship inside the app — only ML models download on first use

description.p: GPU-accelerated song creation and web-based creator

ul.li: In-app GPU acceleration for stem separation and transcription via WebGPU (WASM fallback) — no Python or extra installs
Create karaoke files from the web admin, including file upload
Word-level lyric timing from timestamped Whisper models with vocal-energy refinement

description.p: UI improvements

ul.li: Improved lyric editor: clicking text field now selects the row
Enhanced selection visibility with better color contrast
Text inputs now more clearly editable

description.p: Early development release with core karaoke features

ul.li: Multi-format support (KAI, CDG, MP3+CDG)
Real-time stem mixing and vocal effects
Web-based song request system
Auto-tune system with pitch correction
Butterchurn visualizations
